source: sklearn.datasets.load_digits; 8x8 scans of real handwritten digits
baseline: 2-component PCA fit on training data only
selection: lowest validation reconstruction MSE for VAE; test not used for selection
limitations: Single seed; bootstrap quantifies test-sample variability conditional on fitted models; VAE decoder at latent mean; reconstruction comparison only; PCA and VAE share latent dimension but differ in capacity and objective.
